mostWorthwhile.text: Tracing the refusal from its ranking fields to the published revenue rule and reserved-capacity log was most worthwhile: each record added a distinct piece of the explanation.

leastWorthwhile.text: The bike preparation was sensible but relatively predictable, with three successive fitting steps before the trip.

surprise.text: The van was idle because its availability had been sold to someone else, not simply because the depot lacked a vehicle.

arbitrary.text: My initial attempt to compare the export directly with the policy was reasonable but incompatible; the automatic alternative exposed the ranking fields, making the required intermediate step clearer.

continue.text: Yes. The investigation connected a practical local workaround to a larger infrastructure decision, and I would be curious to see whether the neighbors can challenge it.
